provenance.tagPolicy: Stable semantic-version Git tags: v?MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, optionally followed by +build metadata; prereleases are excluded.
provenance.tagOrder: Ascending semantic version; exact tag names are retained in each fingerprint record.
provenance.fileScope: Tracked templates/hooks/**/*.mjs blobs found independently in each stable tag tree; a path is associated only with tags where it exists.
provenance.workingTreePolicy: A workingTree fingerprint is included only when current working-tree bytes differ from every tagged fingerprint for that path.
